description: This Java class 'SizeNode' extends 'PcbNode' and models a size attribute (width and height) for a PCB element, with a constructor that parses these dimensions from a list of children objects.

classes.name: SizeNode
classes.description: Represents a size with width and height for a PCB node, extending PcbNode.

methods.name: SizeNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes size dimensions from child nodes, parsing from strings to doubles.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SizeNode showing width and height.
